channel.title: Pier & Point · Arterra
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Arterra (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Arterra: The map notes said about 275 units; the cited SocketSite post says 268, so a dated note was added. The 2009 built year now cites the DataSF Assessor roll for the per-unit condominium lots at 300 Berry, the 2007 topping-out milestone cites its SocketSite post (16 floors, spring 2008 target), and the comparison with other condo-mapped towers no longer lists Avalon II and III.
item.description: The map notes said about 275 units; the cited SocketSite post says 268, so a dated note was added. Source: SocketSite, 2006-04 (https://socketsite.com/archives/2006/04/the_arterra_cle.html); DataSF Assessor Historical Secured Property Tax Rolls, 300 Berry St condominium lots (https://data.sf.gov/resource/wv5m-vpq2.json?parcel_number=8704012); SocketSite, 2007-07-30 (https://socketsite.com/archives/2007/07/arterra_300_berry_tops_off_and_aims_for_a_spring_openin.html); DataSF Parcels (https://data.sfgov.org/Geographic-Locations-and-Boundaries/Parcels-Active-and-Retired/acdm-wktn).
